notes: This lock drives one-time repository vendoring on Windows ARM64.
Normal ARM64 builds and deployments consume runtime/arm64 only and do not download third-party runtimes.
goz replaces the previous Everything runtime. gozd is the elevated MFT/USN index service and goz.exe is the unprivileged query client.
The complete Codex CLI is vendored as the upstream .exe.zst asset so it remains below GitHub's 100 MiB per-file limit; Node 24 materializes codex.exe offline during deployment.
Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is an operating-system prerequisite; only the build SDK/loader is vendored.
